status: PREFLIGHT_PASSED — approved to run seed-42 11-fold completion
preflight_evidence: 8 focused tests passed; JSON and Python compilation passed; output path unique; provenance-preserving reuse links for completed folds 2/6/10 resolve to COMPLETE artifacts.
tier: pilot; locked full benchmark; not publishable until metric audit and three-seed confirmation
author_override: The 2/6/10 promotion gate failed shape noninferiority, anchor accuracy and coverage. On 2026-10-04 the author explicitly authorised completing the locked 11-fold seed-42 benchmark for a complete paper draft. This does not retroactively turn the gate into a pass.
dataset: MMECG public loso_v2, 11 strict subject-independent folds, 8-second full-support WSST subject pool
model: Frozen A1 dual-head REM-Net: shared WSST stem/TCN, ECG Shape Recovery head, independent Q/R/S/T logits; frozen reference-free A2 physiological decoder
reuse: Exact seed-42 folds 2/6/10 from q1_dual_head_interaction_gate/A1 are reused by provenance-preserving symlink; only the remaining eight folds train.
frozen_training: Shape L1 + 0.5*(1-PCC) + 0.3*Q/R/S/T BCE; AdamW lr 1e-4 weight decay 1e-4; maximum 100 epochs; patience 15.
checkpoint_selection: Validation-only lexicographic selection: highest ECG Shape Recovery PCC, then lowest RMSE, then highest independent-anchor macro F1@100 ms. Test opens once after checkpoint freeze.
frozen_decoder: R peaks at probability >=0.5 and distance 40 samples; Q=max 5--100 ms before R; S=max 5--100 ms after R; T=max 40--450 ms after S and before next R. No test-derived tuning.
aggregation: Per-fold results followed by unweighted fold-macro mean and population standard deviation. Shape-200 is explicitly beat-normalised morphology evidence, not continuous ECG.
next_decision: After seed 42 completes, audit all 11 folds. Only if retained for the paper run identical seeds 123 and 2024; no intervening model or threshold changes.
